detailed_description:
The target video is a photorealistic AAA racing-game render in the style of Forza Horizon, captured at maximum settings with path-traced lighting, ray-traced reflections, and dense photogrammetry-grade detail on every surface. The light is a clear midday sun standing high overhead and slightly to the right, casting short, crisp, dark shadows directly beneath the cars and the guard rails, under a deep blue sky with thin high cirrus wisps, with saturated colors, deep contrast, high dynamic range, faint sunlit haze over the distant hills, and clean cinematic grading; the asphalt is completely dry. Only slight speed blur on the road surface is allowed, while cars, barriers, signs, and scenery stay perfectly sharp. There is no HUD, speedometer, minimap, lap or position counter, timer, watermark, caption, or overlay text, and no flat-colored or segmentation-map look.
[Shot 1] The camera is one continuous chase-camera tracking shot from behind and slightly above <Subject 1> that follows the exact path and sway of <Video 1>, with no zoom, no pan, and no reframing, and there are no cuts. The shot begins from <Picture 1>: <Subject 1> sits in the lower center of the frame, its deep navy paint glinting under the high sun, its short shadow pooled directly beneath the green skirts and carbon diffuser. Just ahead in the center, the sky-blue sedan of <Subject 2> with its orange center stripe and number "14" leads by a few car lengths; on the left half of the road the lime-yellow and sky-blue GT runs slightly further ahead beside the Armco carrying "HALDEN", "ORBIS TYRES", and "SKYLARK" boards; far ahead on the right the small white car turns in past the red-and-white kerb of <Subject 3> under the red "AURELIS" gantry. Throughout the drive, every car's position and movement, the course of the road, and the camera's path and sway follow <Video 1> exactly. The dry asphalt road of <Subject 3> winds between galvanized Armco rails through right-hand bends, left-right S-bends, and long right-hand sweepers, with red-and-white kerbs on the apexes, a broad white-painted run-off strip along the edge in places, yellow distance boards such as "100" and "50" on the verge, black sponsor boards on the barriers, the red "AURELIS" gantry passing overhead, and lone trees or small groups of trees on the rolling green hills. The rivals of <Subject 2> sometimes run just ahead, sometimes pull away and shrink into small shapes far down the road, and sometimes draw level and drop back past the edge of the frame; other rivals can come up from behind, draw alongside, and cut in just ahead, leaving <Subject 1> at times running alone on an empty track. <Subject 1> sweeps smoothly through the bends, drifts slightly across the lane and settles back toward center, and rides over the kerbs on the apexes. The paint, liveries, dry surface, and midday light stay exactly as <Picture 1> shows them. Engine notes climb through upshifts and swell as rivals pass close, and tires rumble over the kerbs; no speech is heard, and no text other than the existing sponsor boards, gantry panels, distance boards, and car liveries appears on screen.

overall_soundscape:
A high-revving racing engine roars continuously from <Subject 1>, rising and falling with sharp upshifts and downshifts, crackles and pops on the overrun, and the whine of a straight-cut gearbox, while the engines of the rival cars add passing growls that swell as they come close and fade as they drop away. Tires hum and scrub on the dry asphalt, rattle over the kerbs, and squeal lightly through the bends, and wind rushes steadily over the bodywork. The open countryside around the circuit adds a faint breeze over the grass, distant birdsong, and the far-off murmur of other engines echoing across the hills; there is no speech or dialogue anywhere.
